fact: what sources exist, and which of them may execute
not_implied: a catalog row is not an authorization
an adapter existing is not an authorization
governance complete is not a permitted request: robots, attribution, collector capability and runtime readiness are conditions of the moment and are checked per request
retired wins outright; it is evaluated before the ladder
why_removed: it restated a guarantee the database already enforces - migration 0048 makes an unsigned approved decision unwritable - in a place nobody could audit, and at 1,000 sources it would have made every activation a deploy
